reviews.comment: Passionate and knowledgeable professor. Class is structured around a lot of hands-on activities such as a labs and group projects, but he gives good feedback. Definitely come to lecture and office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Does not seem to care for his students and their life events. Lectures are long and terribly boring.

Missing 3 questions on any quiz is a B, so take plenty of notes. Quizzes include info from books and lectures, so DON'T SKIP. It's not too boring if you're actually interested in urban planning. The written assignments aren't bad, but make sure your in-text citations are (Author, Year) because the TA will take off points (it's not on the rubric).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you had to take URPN 202, this class will be nothing new. Lectures are incredibly boring. The quizzes suck but he's an easy grader on everything else. He doesn't care for why students miss class and was overall unwilling to help students that missed quizzes or work due to life events (ei. weddings, flooding apartments, and illness).
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He provided good insight and guidance as far as professional development for our future careers. Was ready to help when we had questions and provided detailed feedback for our improvement.

A nice guy but lectures are extremely boring and hard to follow. Multiple quizzes that are extremely difficult and mostly pull from the lecture. Only a few assignments are given, but the grade breakdown for the class makes it difficult to pick your grade back up. Not an easy geography class, so if looking for an easy class to take do not take.

The lectures are hard to understand and he goes off about ideas that are rarely present in his in class quizzes. The TA's are tough graders on the quizzes and papers. A simple class has been made to be nothing but tedious and confusing. If you look into the grade distributions, you will see he has no hesitation to give out F's. Avoid if possible!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not as easy as I thought. Everything on the quizzes comes from his lectures and lecture is so boring so its kinda hard to do well on the quizzes. The assignments are fairly easy/simple and there are no tests so I would recommend to anyone who needs a fairly easy geography credit. Not interesting or fun though so be aware of that. Nice guy though
He's monotone, boring and its the same old material. semi-complex quizzes, and 4 assignments. If you want to really learn chose someone else, reasonable A, take him. Also doesn't really give feedback

He offered extra credit. Four assignments that were easy and easily graded. Real nice guy and understanding. I made a D because I was a bad student not because he was a bad prof. Easy class with some quizzes that were easy too. Don't need the text book. No exams, and quizzes come from lecture slides.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved this class. He gives a few quizzes throughout the semester that you need to be prepared for, but they aren't super though. He also has four assignments which are super easy 250 word documents covering the topic of your choice pertaining to the class. Loved it, super clear and easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy class. Around 6 quizzes (bi-weekly) which can be aced by just studying the lecture slides. 4 assignments. This adds up to a 100. Easy to get a 10/10 in the assignments. Drops the lowest quiz grade. Will bump up your grade if you are near the margin.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY
